text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 27 July 2003, accepted by by General Manager eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag, 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El-Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector.
Technical Specifications
No. of filters | 3 [ type p 14 5841 ]
Material | Steel plate construction vessel
Design vacuum | 5000 mm WG
Safety Precautions
Issue work order including the teamwork names
Use Safety fences with caution marks to surround the work area.
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Stop the fanes.
Be sure that the dust evacuation system is out of service
Compassed air hose.
Articles.
Special cleaning system.
Maintenance tool set.
Work to be Carried Out
Check the differential 
 pressure. The reading must be between [ 50 mm -100 mm 
 ] WG.
Check the compressed air [6 7 bar].
Check the function of the diaphragm 
 valves.
Check the dust supply line and dust 
 discharge system.
Clean the filter elements.
Check the filter element gasket and 
 replace it if it is required.
Check the filter element sealing 
 washers at the bottom of the filter lament.
Check and repair the filter element 
 leaks.
Check the fan balancing.
Remove the dust deposition on the fan 
 blades.
Replace fan worn blades.
Replace the worn bearing.
